body.name: Legal realization and relative-transfer handle
body.construction: Start from the finite sign, survivor-total, and active-cut decomposition of the unconditional capacity map on the legal tangent-score domains \(\mathcal D_b\); on each piece, lift the required capacity direction to a nearby element of \(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{obs}}\) by perturbing legal latent response-type masses and instrument propensities. Couple the multinomial score and \(G^*\) through common square-root coordinates, stratify by the common envelope scale, and treat exact zero scale by a separate local-flatness branch. Values of \(d_b\) off \(\mathcal D_b\) are excluded from the lift argument. The target object derived by this handle is the comparison in \(\text{oeq:legal-relative-comparison}\).
